title: Clarify the standalone Codex REPL AutoApprove sandbox contract
outcome: Users can distinguish the standalone REPL's existing AutoApprove behavior from the shared app-server sandbox-cap contract; runtime parity remains an explicit owner decision.
acceptance: Document whether the standalone REPL uses the shared sandbox-cap responder or retains its older native on-request and unconditional command/file/permissions auto-accept behavior, without implying unimplemented parity.

If runtime parity is chosen, obtain the policy owner's scope decision and cover explicit network/write, FullAccess, humanCommand and genuine-input behavior through the REPL's actual response path; a documentation-only choice changes no runtime policy.
